provenance_note: Four thousand declared viewers and 600 events, which is comfortably enough on its own. The repeat quota is the only thing that pushes it under: floor(600 * 0.2) = 120 repeated events leave 480 fresh draws, short of the 500 distinct viewers the class requires. This isolates the repeat term of the rule from the pool and event-count terms, so dropping it cannot go unnoticed.
